note: vespera_core: Schema gains property_names (OpenAPI propertyNames, read and written). vespera_macro: the map form of an externally tagged #[serde(other)] variant names the unknown key with propertyNames: {not: {enum: [known]}} instead of not: {anyOf: [{required: [..]}]}; generic instances (Tree_i32, Tree_i32.Input, an inlined Page<User>) document the #[serde(default = "fn")] values of the generic definition; in a long-lived proc-macro server a stored #[derive(Schema)] entry whose item was renamed, moved to another file or deleted no longer raises a false duplicate-name error. vespera: the Validated docs and the README state that unbounded float fields accept NaN / inf through Query / Form / Path / multipart.
